title: The 500 Fellowship (500 Global flagship program in San Francisco; formerly the Flagship Accelerator)
deadline_note: No application deadline is published. 500.co lists the program dates as November 30, 2026 - April 9, 2027 and says "Apply to be considered for the next batch"; the application portal's active batch ("Flagship Batch 37") is flagged as rolling with no applications deadline. Which batch a new application would be considered for is not stated.
amount: Up to $50K from 500 Global upon acceptance, with potential for up to $1M more depending on progress (equity/terms not published on the program page)

summary.at_a_glance: 500 Global's flagship program, now branded "The 500 Fellowship": four months in person in San Francisco for early-stage founders "building for the U.S. and the world". Accepted companies can receive up to $50K right away with potential for up to $1M more as they progress. Applications go through 500 Global's own portal (Aplica), which still calls the program the "Flagship Accelerator".
summary.what_they_offer: Investment: "Companies accepted into the 500 Fellowship can receive up to $50K right away with the potential for up to $1M more as you progress." Network: 500 Global's network of VCs, resources, mentorship and market insights across geographies. Mentorship: operator-investors, alumni founder coaches, entrepreneurs in residence, mentors and guest speakers. Format: weekly group day, 1:1s, and a showcase at the end. Also access to "over $1M in credits in the 500 FounderHub". The FAQ says participation is free ("No. It's absolutely free.").
summary.what_theyre_looking_for: "This is for the top 0.1% of founders. We meet builders as early as day 0 who have a nonobvious deep insight on the market and an unfair advantage to get to the people who need it the most. We're looking for founders who've started building and thinking globally already. You might have just started or you already have your first users, revenue or pilots. You're in the U.S. already, or you plan to be within six months." FAQ: "Early U.S. traction helps. If you're not there yet, apply anyway." 500 is "sector agnostic and invests in all tech- enabled solutions from AI, deep tech, infrastructure, applications, enterprise, consumer, marketplaces, SaaS, and many more."
summary.who_can_apply: Early-stage founders of tech-enabled companies in any sector, anywhere, who are in the U.S. or plan to be within six months and can spend four months in person in San Francisco (co-working space in Mission Bay). "On average 30-40% of a batch is international." Re-applying after a rejection is encouraged.
summary.how_to_apply: 1) Click Apply on 500.co/founders/flagship, which opens flagship.aplica.500.co. 2) Create an account (first name, last name, email, password) or sign in. 3) Complete the application form (Intro, The Business, The Team, The Basics), including a pitch-deck link and a cap-table upload. 4) "Selected applicants will have a series of interviews with the team." 5) Kick off in San Francisco. The FAQ says every application is reviewed individually and a response "could take up to a few weeks".
summary.worth_noting: The form asks for six months of monthly revenue and monthly customer/user counts, burn rate and cash balance as required numeric fields, so a pre-revenue company still has to enter numbers. A cap table file upload and a pitch-deck link (viewable in incognito) are required. The 500.co page was rebranded to "500 Fellowship" (page says updated Sep 2026) while the portal and the form wording still say "accelerator program". The older "$150K for 6%" terms quoted on third-party sites are not on the current official page.

portal.platform: Aplica - 500 Global's own application platform (flagship.aplica.500.co); the form is backed by a HubSpot form ("GAP Accelerator Application B37")
portal.notes: An account is required before the form is shown: sign up at /auth/signup with First Name, Last Name, Email Address and Password ("Must have at least 8 characters in length, lower case (a-z), upper case (A-Z) and numbers (0-9)."). The sign-up page also contains an off-screen input named "phone" (tabindex -1, autocomplete off) that looks like a honeypot and should be left empty. The sign-in page says "Sign in to continue your application or check your application status", so a started application can be resumed. No CAPTCHA was seen on the sign-up or sign-in pages and the backing HubSpot form has CAPTCHA disabled, but the pages after login were not seen. Whether email verification is required is unknown. Support: aplica.support@500.co.

questions_note: How obtained: the application form sits behind a login, and no account was created. However, the public landing page of the official portal (flagship.aplica.500.co) ships the complete form definition for the active batch ("Flagship Batch 37", form "GAP Accelerator Application B37") in its page data. All questions, help text, options, required flags and order are taken verbatim from that definition on 2026-11-24, and the field list was cross-checked against the public definition of the backing HubSpot form (same 65 fields). The rendered post-login screens were NOT seen, so page breaks, on-screen layout and any client-side validation are unconfirmed. Details: (1) The portal reports 52 questions, which equals the number of required top-level fields; there are 57 visible top-level fields plus 9 conditional follow-ups. (2) Conditional fields: "If yes, please list the other name(s):" (shown only when "Does your company go by any other names?" = Yes); "When's your launch date?" (shown only when "Has your product or service launched?" = No); "When did your product launch?" (shown only when "Has your product or service launched?" = Yes, it's in private beta / Yes, it's in public beta / Yes, it's public); "State (US)" (shown only when "Where is your company physically headquartered?" = United States); "If yes, how much? (Please use USD)" (shown only when "Have you already raised any outside funding?" = Yes); "If yes, who are your current investors?" (shown only when "Have you already raised any outside funding?" = Yes); "Please describe your company's progress since you last applied." (shown only when "Have you applied to 500 previously?" = Yes); "Please list the name of each company below and give us a sentence or two about what happened with each company listed." (shown only when "Have you or any of your co-founders started a company before?" = Yes); "Who referred you?" (shown only when "How did you hear about us?" = Investor / Previous 500 Batch Company / 500 Global Staff / Other / Misk500 Meetups / Referral). (3) Option lists for "Which industry/sector classification applies best to your company?", "Where is your company physically headquartered?" and "Where is your company incorporated?" are supplied by the portal at render time and are not in the page data, so options are left empty. (The backing HubSpot form lists these industries: Fintech, Health, Smart Cities, Biotech, Collaboration, Entertainment, IT Tools, Security, Sports, Real Estate, Transportation, Media, HR, Education, Marketing, Customer Success, Retail, eCommerce, Industrial, Software (Sector-Agnostic) - the portal list may differ.) (4) For the six monthly revenue fields and six monthly customer fields, the help text is the group prompt shown above them. For "I agree to receive communications from 500 Global." the help text is the privacy notice shown above it. (5) Word limits ("150 words or fewer" etc.) are stated as help text; whether the form enforces them is unknown. No character limits are defined. (6) Placeholder texts shown inside fields: "Describe what your company does in no more than 3 sentences. Give us your best elevator pitch:" -> "500 Global is a seed fund & a network of startup programs."; "Please share your company's website:" -> "www.500.co"; "Six months ago?" -> "USD actual"; "Five months ago?" -> "USD actual"; "Four months ago?" -> "USD actual"; "Three months ago?" -> "USD actual"; "Two months ago?" -> "USD actual"; "Last month?" -> "USD actual"; "What is your current monthly burn rate" -> "USD actual"; "What is your current cash balance" -> "USD actual"; "If yes, who are your current investors?" -> "Investor one; Investor two; etc."; "Please list all co-founders along with links to LinkedIn profiles for each, including yourself." -> "Full name, URL; etc."; "First name:" -> "Christine"; "... and last name:" -> "Tsai"; "Primary contact's email address:" -> "Please use your company email address."; "Primary contact's phone number:" -> "+X (XXX) XXX - XXXX"; "Product demonstration video:" -> "Please upload a video (only if you deem it necessary).". (7) Hidden internal fields in the definition were left out: Processing Team [processing_team]; Next Workflow [next_workflow]; Internal - Batch number [internal_batch_number]; Batch Applied For... [batch_applied_for]; Source [rel]; utm_campaign [utm_campaign]; utm_source [utm_source]; Would you like to apply to a specific track? [would_you_like_to_apply_to_a_specific_track_]. (8) The portal copy marks "I agree to receive communications from 500 Global." and the phone number as required, while the HubSpot copy marks them optional; the portal copy is reported here. (9) "Verticals" is a visible, optional checkbox field with no further prompt.
